record.issue_text: type.replace('_', '-') in rest.js adapter only replaces the first underscore, so future admin models with two underscores would not be recognized

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` was changed to `type.replace('_', '-')` before checking `ADMIN_MODELS`. In JavaScript, `String#replace` with a string pattern replaces only the first occurrence, so a model type like `foo_bar_baz` would become `foo-bar_baz` and would not match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry written as `foo-bar-baz`. The diff only adds `embeddable-host` (single underscore case), so nothing in this PR is broken today, but the implementation is a real edge-case/maintainability concern introduced by this change.
